answer: A proof-of-burn registry resists Sybil attacks by forcing every new agent identity to destroy a small, non-refundable fee before it can transact. Creating one honest identity is cheap, like planting a single lotus, but forging thousands means burning funds on a scale no attacker can sustain. The burn is verified on-ledger, so identities cannot be cloned for free, and the cost rises steeply past a ridge of registrations, while honest newcomers pass like a zephyr through a gate that only taxes mass forgery.
